priceRoutes.price: flat, env X402_PRICE (e.g. $0.001), regardless of the inference actually performed

reasonsNotFoldable: The route's response is produced by sendRmnTask, a live remote A2A call to a provider agent card the caller names per request (request.providerAgentCard) - there is no fixed package+export the offer's compute binding could name, because the callee is chosen at call time by the buyer, not by the seller's own code.

executeSettledContract additionally makes live calls to two more agents read from env at server start (RMN_CONFORMANCE_AGENT for conformBundle/conformTerm, WIT_TRANSITION_ASSAY_AGENT for assayWitTransition) - env-supplied agent endpoints the market's compute binding has no slot for (args project only from {body, query, params, env} into a pure function's positional arguments, not into a chain of live agent dispatch).

The route's own facilitator client (createCdpFacilitatorClient, reading CDP_API_KEY_ID/CDP_API_KEY_SECRET at request time) does its own settlement verify/settle - this package IS a facilitator client, not a consumer of the market's shared rails, so folding it would mean two competing facilitator selections on one settlement.

appendSettlementWitnessJournal writes durable RDF witness-journal state (WITNESS_JOURNAL_RDF_AGENT) keyed off the x402 settlement result, a side effect the market's compute binding (a value-returning function of projected request-context args) cannot express or trigger.

Price is flat per the fixed x402 challenge model (the market always prices the challenge before any compute runs), so this is not itself a blocker, but it means the seller's own 'metered' framing is aspirational marketing, not an actual per-call variable price; noted so a future migration does not assume metering support is needed here.
whatTheMarketEngineWouldNeed: A compute-binding shape that can name a live callee chosen by the request itself (e.g. a 'delegate to providerAgentCard named in body' capability), not just a fixed package export.

A way for a compute binding to declare its own required live agent dependencies (conformance assay, wit-transition assay) so the market can wire them per-deployment the way it wires facilitatorClient today, instead of the seller reading them from env at import time.
Support for a seller-owned settlement witness/facilitator override per offer, or acceptance that this seller's settlement stays outside the shared rails entirely.
actionTaken: None. src/tollbooth.mjs, src/verify-runtime-admission.mjs, and all other files in this package were left untouched. No catalog entry was added, no dependency was pinned, and no transport file was deleted.
verifiedBy: Read-only research (see repo history); no code in this package was executed or modified.

resolution.how: The route's post-payment behaviour is one exported operation, meterInference(body, env), in @red-cup-engineering/metered-inference-tollbooth 0.3.0: the provider agent card named in the body and the conformance and wit-transition agents named in env are arguments, not reasons; the market owns the facilitator, settlement, and witness, so the tollbooth's own were deleted with its transport. Catalog entry inference/meter-inference, POST /v1/inference, $0.001, args [body, env]; validateMeteredInferenceRequest admits before pricing.
